project_type: pnpm monorepo (TypeScript). SnapURL URL-shortener with apps/api (NestJS), apps/redirect (Fastify hot path), apps/worker (job loop/Lambda), web (Next.js), and shared packages (@snapurl/database drizzle+postgres-js, @snapurl/domain, @snapurl/contract).
language: TypeScript (ESM, NodeNext module resolution; relative imports use .js extensions).
build_system: pnpm workspaces. Root scripts: corepack pnpm type-check, corepack pnpm build, corepack pnpm test. Toolchain: prepend Node 22 to PATH then use corepack pnpm.
test_framework: vitest. Some tests are DB-gated integration tests (describeDb) that require Postgres and SKIP when DATABASE_URL is unset. Non-DB unit tests (e.g. analytics.service.test.ts) run anywhere.
build_command: corepack pnpm install; then corepack pnpm build (or scope to the api package). No migration required for this task.
test_command: corepack pnpm test (analytics.service.test.ts is a pure-helper unit test that must stay green with identical assertion count).
verification_instructions: From repo root with Node 22 on PATH: (1) corepack pnpm install (2) corepack pnpm type-check must pass (3) corepack pnpm build must pass (4) corepack pnpm test must pass for non-DB tests; DB-gated integration tests SKIP locally (Postgres 18 cannot start in sandbox) and are validated by CI. (5) grep confirms apps/api/src/analytics/analytics.service.ts imports NOTHING from @snapurl/database (no Drizzle query builders) and issues no query outside the adapter.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. No DB migration for this task (behavior-preserving refactor only).
setup_instructions: corepack pnpm install at repo root installs all workspace deps. Run bash with cwd set to a repo subdir (absolute cwd elsewhere triggers spawn bwrap issues); prepend Node 22 then corepack pnpm.
environment_constraints: OPEN INTERNET available. Postgres 18 cannot start in sandbox so DB-gated integration tests SKIP locally and are validated by CI (required check 'Type-check, build, test' in the 'Verify' workflow). Rely on type-check + build + non-DB unit tests locally. NO DB migration, NO behavior change, NO ClickHouse/Timescale adapter (document the seam only).
contribution_requirements: Conventional-commit style PR titles. Cannot push/PR (orchestrator publishes); commit locally only. Changes must be surgical and behavior-preserving: move Drizzle queries VERBATIM into the adapter; do not 'improve' any query. The whole risk named by issue #284 is that a second pass over analytics queries introduces subtle differences between stores.
key_patterns: PORTS: apps/redirect/src/resolver.ts and apps/redirect/src/click-sink.ts define ports as `export interface Xxx { ... }` + `export class PostgresXxx implements Xxx { constructor(private readonly db: Database) {} ... }`, with a header block comment documenting the swappable seam (production adapter vs local Postgres). Mirror this exactly. NEST DI: apps/api/src/database/database.module.ts declares `export const SYMBOL = Symbol("NAME")` tokens (DB, READ_DB, DB_HANDLE) and provides them via `{ provide: SYMBOL, inject: [...], useFactory: (...) => ... }`. Services inject with `@Inject(TOKEN) private readonly x: T`. Use the SAME token+useFactory pattern to bind ANALYTICS_READER -> PostgresAnalyticsReader constructed off the READ_DB handle. Contract types (@snapurl/contract): Analytics, Breakdown, TimeseriesPoint, AnalyticsQuery are zod-inferred types in packages/contract/src/analytics.ts.
relevant_files: apps/api/src/analytics/analytics.service.ts (282 lines. @Injectable AnalyticsService. overview() issues Drizzle queries via this.readDb over clickDaily/breakdownDaily/conversions/links. Also has exported pure helpers: applyCityFloor, CITY_MIN_CLICKS, OTHER_CITIES, iso, windowFor, percentChange, fillSeries plus FLAGS/COUNTRY_NAMES maps. The queries move to the adapter; the store-agnostic logic (floor, country-name/flag mapping, period math, delta computation, assembling the Analytics response) STAYS in the service.)
apps/api/src/analytics/analytics.module.ts (providers: [AnalyticsService], exports: [AnalyticsService]. Add ANALYTICS_READER provider bound to PostgresAnalyticsReader via READ_DB.)

apps/api/src/analytics/analytics.service.test.ts (25 assertions across windowFor/percentChange/fillSeries/iso/applyCityFloor. Pure-helper tests: unaffected by the refactor, must stay green. Add a NEW focused test proving the service assembles a correct Analytics response against a FAKE AnalyticsReader.)
apps/redirect/src/resolver.ts (PATTERN to mirror: interface LinkResolver + class PostgresLinkResolver implements LinkResolver, with a seam-documenting header comment).
apps/redirect/src/click-sink.ts (PATTERN to mirror: interface ClickSink + class PostgresClickSink implements ClickSink).
apps/api/src/database/database.module.ts (DI token + useFactory pattern; READ_DB is the read-replica Database handle the adapter must take in its constructor).

apps/api/src/conversions/conversions.service.ts (OUT OF SCOPE for this task: distinct dashboard read path returning ConversionsReport, plus a read-then-write record() on the primary. Documented as a follow-up candidate for the same port. The AnalyticsReader covers only the conversion TOTALS that overview() reads.)
packages/contract/src/analytics.ts (Analytics, Breakdown, TimeseriesPoint, AnalyticsQuery type definitions the port shape must be driven by).
directory_structure: apps/api/src/analytics = analytics feature module (controller/service/test) + NEW analytics.reader.ts (port + Postgres adapter). apps/api/src/database = DI for DB/READ_DB. apps/redirect = has the existing LinkResolver/ClickSink ports to mirror. packages/contract = zod contract types.
